questionText:

Surya Engineering Tools Ltd. implemented F.W. Taylor's Differential Piece Wage System to motivate shopfloor machinists. The management instituted two distinct wage rates: a higher piece rate of Rs. 50 per unit for workers who produce standard output or more, and a lower piece rate of Rs. 40 per unit for workers who produce less than standard output. The difference of Rs. 380 for a mere shortfall of 4 units served as an immense financial incentive for Suresh to improve.
